findings.title: Federated rules are no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: This refactor replaces the previous `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` check with `false`. `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` now forwards only the ruler rule and a group identifier, so federated-group metadata is lost and the Update/Delete/Pause abilities can be allowed whenever ordinary permissions permit them. This regresses the prior protection for federated Mimir rules and can expose edits or deletions that the UI previously blocked.

findings.title: Prometheus-only list items cannot expose pause or delete actions
findings.body: The new `GrafanaRuleListItem` supplies `promRule` but no `rulerRule`. As a result, the Delete menu item is hidden by this `rulerRule` guard even when `canDelete` is true; the Pause item has the same ruler-rule requirement at line 123. This prevents users from pausing or deleting Grafana rules directly from the list, despite the new Prometheus-rule ability checks and the identifier-based delete callback.

findings.title: Silence menu action does not open a drawer for Prometheus-only rules
findings.body: The new Grafana list item passes its rule as `promRule` and leaves `rule` undefined. The menu can still show Silence based on that Prometheus rule, but clicking it only sets `showSilenceDrawer`; this condition prevents the drawer from rendering because it requires a Grafana ruler rule. Users therefore see a Silence action that does nothing in the new list view.

findings.title: Rule view links no longer preserve the return destination
findings.body: This URL omits the `returnTo` value that the removed loader added to Grafana rule view links. When a user opens a rule from a filtered or searched list and uses the detail page's return navigation, Grafana can no longer restore that list context and instead falls back to its default destination.
